verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Adyen Issuing has a webhook system (webhook-types.md) and a dispute-handling API for chargebacks, but the pack never shows explicit webhook events for clearing/capture, refund, or reversal transactions, nor does it document a stable transaction identifier tying auth to post-auth events. Only relayed-authorization webhooks (for real-time auth decisions) and generic 'configuration webhooks' (account holder/balance/instrument changes) are evidenced — not the full post-auth transaction lifecycle. missing for 10: explicit clearing/refund/reversal webhook documentation, confirmation of stable transaction IDs linking auth to settlement events, and any chargeback-webhook (vs. dispute API) evidence.
